title: 第2章  正经人谁苦修？
slug: 长生让你延续香火没让你量产仙帝
content_zh:
青云山脚，棚户区。
这里是宗门为了安置遣散弟子搭建的安置区。
说是安置区，其实就是一片乱糟糟的土坯房。
这里有刚被遣退下山的老修，也有在这里生活了几代人的凡人家族。
原本李长生想找一个陌生村落生活的，但是在仙门脚下，半点不由人。
被告知遣散的弟子。
无法离开青云宗管辖之地！
大道无情。
可是比大道更无情的是宗门啊！
李长生吐槽一声，随后在安置区较为偏远的地方，挑选了一栋不起眼的平板房搬了进去。
虽然平板房是宗门的产业，但是长期没有人居住，屋里遍地灰尘，蛛网结满房梁。
不过，好消息是，房子空间蛮大的。
李长生走进客厅，将包裹往地上一放。
随后看了向站在其身后的少女。
“后悔跟着我吗？”
江翠萍摇了摇头，声音依旧有些害怕：“不后悔。仙师救我脱离苦海，我应该感激才对。”
李长生笑了笑：
“不后悔就好。”
“去做饭吧。”
“好。”江翠萍手脚麻利地找来枯枝生火，淘米下锅。

不一会儿。
米香就从锅里传过来了。
李长生坐在客厅，看着忙碌做饭的江翠萍，心底竟然升起一丝久违的暖意。
这六十年，他一个人吃饭，一个人修炼，一个人面对冰冷的墙壁。
孤独就像毒蛇一样啃噬着灵魂。
而此刻这缕人间烟火气，让其那颗枯寂的心，稍微活泛了一些。
这就是人间烟火吗？
好像还不错。
李长生喃喃自语。
晚饭很简单，两碗稀粥，一碟咸菜。
江翠萍不敢上桌，端着碗蹲在灶台边。
在她们主家，婆娘是不能上主桌的。
李长生皱了皱眉，招手道：“过来坐着吃。”
“可是……”
“别可是了，我让你过来。”
“好吧！”
少女受宠若惊。
战战兢兢地坐了半个屁股。
吃饭的速度很快。
很明显，没有习惯在主桌上吃饭，有些害怕。

夜深了。
外面寒风呼啸，拍打着破旧的窗棂。
江翠萍局促地站在床边，双手紧紧抓着衣角，指节发白。
她知道接下来会发生什么。
但是不拒绝，
因为这是她的命，也是她唯一价值。
无论命是好的，还是坏的，都应该接着。
李长生叹了口气，看着镜子里苍老的脸，满头白发，皱纹堆叠。
再看看眼前正值青春的少女。
如果在前世这女娃应该还在上学吧！
在修仙界却年纪轻轻就要学会伺候男人了。
感叹一声：
“委屈你了。”
江翠萍身子一颤，抬起头，眼眶微红：“不委屈。仙师给饭吃，还给地方住，翠萍这辈子给仙师当牛做马都愿意。”
这是实话。
在乱世。
能活着就是最大的福分。
而女人能否活着就看跟着的男人。
“不用叫我仙师了。”
“我已经被遣退了，过往就忘却吧！”

“以后你叫我长生即可。”
江翠萍：“好的，仙师。”
李长生：“我刚刚说什么来的？”
江翠萍：“……好的，长生。”
李长生吹灭了蜡烛。
两人躺在了那张吱呀作响的木床上。
水到渠成。
多子多福。
数个小时之后。
李长生感觉达到了极乐。
怀中的女人却累坏了，静静躺在床上，睡了过去。
虽然李长生年迈。
但是老当益壮。
普通的女人真的角力不过他。
就当李长生准备闭上眼睛休息的时候，脑海中突然响起了一道冰冷的电子合成电子音。
【叮！】
【检测到宿主娶妻江翠萍。】
【视为建立家族。】
【家族兴旺系统激活。】
李长生闻言，浑身一僵，浑浊的眼神瞬间爆发出骇人的精光。

穿越者的标配。
系统足足迟到了整整六十年才来？
能来就是好事。
统子，赶紧给我奖励吧！
李长生高兴得几乎跳起来。
下一秒，系统冰冷的提示音便传过来了。
【虽然配偶为凡人，但宿主初次建立家族，触发新手暴击奖励。】
【奖励一：寿元+ 20年、】
【奖励二：修为+ 5年。】
【奖励三：神级龟息术。】
【奖励四：神级伪装术。】
【奖励五：重塑身体机能】
【奖励六：灵符真解。】
直接暴击了五大奖励。
而且每一样都是好东西。
实在太给力了。
看到如此丰富的奖励，即便李长生心态再稳，身体也激动地颤抖。
【是否立刻具现奖励？是/否。】
“当然具现。”
李长生肯定地开口。

随着声音落下，忽然感觉到了身体传来了异样。
一股温和力量凭空出现，席卷全身。
技能融合。
修为增长。
身体机能重塑。
具现奖励的过程中，一点痛苦也没有，很舒服。
有一种上瘾的感觉。
十几分钟后。
蜕变结束。
李长生发现，不但自己的暗伤好了，就连修为都提升了两层。
从练气三层，晋升到了练气五层。
这还真不错啊！
我在青云门蹉跎了六十年。
都无法突破练气四层。
现在一朝娶妻。
却连续突破两级。
与其辛辛苦苦修炼。
还不如娶妻生子多子多福发展家族来得实在。
李长生认为自己已经
枕边人江翠萍，迷迷糊糊中，像是感觉到了什么，疑惑地问：

“长生，怎么啦？”
“没事，睡吧。”
李长生强忍住内心的狂喜开口。
只是江翠萍没有注意到，李长生的声音有活力了很多。
翌日清晨。
阳光透过窗户洒在床头。
江翠萍揉了揉惺忪的睡眼，习惯性起身做饭。
可当其看到李长生的脸时，整个人如遭雷击，呆立当场。
“啊！”
江翠萍惊呼一声，随后捂住嘴。
只见昨晚那个满脸皱纹、头发花白的老头不见了。取而代之的，是一个看起来四十岁出头、身材挺拔、黑发参半的中年男子。虽然眼角还细纹，但面色红润，目光如电，哪里还有半点暮气？
“怎么啦？”李长生正在穿衣，疑惑地问。
“长生，你……你怎么变年轻了？好像年轻了十几岁。”江翠萍声音结结巴巴。
“哦？是吗？”
李长生不动声色笑了笑。
他昨晚只顾着查看系统功能，以及修为的增长了，真没有留意到外貌的变化。
“是的。”江翠萍回答。
李长生：“可能是因为昨日卸下宗门重担，念头通达，多年修行的瓶颈松动，修为精进，自然也就显得年轻了一些。”
content_en:
At the foot of Qingyun Mountain, there is a shanty town.
This is a resettlement area built by the sect to accommodate dismissed disciples.
It is said to be a resettlement area, but it is actually a mess of adobe houses.
There are old cultivators who have just been sent down the mountain, and there are also mortal families who have lived here for several generations.
Originally, Li Changsheng wanted to find a strange village to live in, but at the foot of the Immortal Sect, he couldn't help himself at all.
Disciples who were told to be dismissed.
Unable to leave the place under the jurisdiction of Qingyun Sect!
The road is ruthless.
But what is more ruthless than Dao is the sect!
Li Changsheng complained, and then chose an inconspicuous flat house in a relatively remote part of the resettlement area and moved into it.
Although the flat house is the property of the sect, it has not been inhabited for a long time. The house is covered with dust and cobwebs are covered with the beams.
However, the good news is that the house is quite spacious.
Li Changsheng walked into the living room and put the package on the ground.
Then he looked at the girl standing behind him.
"Do you regret following me?"
Jiang Cuiping shook her head, her voice still a little scared: "I don't regret it. I should be grateful to the immortal master for saving me from the sea of suffering."
Li Changsheng smiled:
"As long as you don't regret it."
"Let's go cook."
"Okay." Jiang Cuiping quickly found dead branches to make a fire, and washed rice for the pot.
Soon.
The aroma of rice came from the pot.
Li Changsheng was sitting in the living room, looking at Jiang Cuiping who was busy cooking, and felt a long-lost warmth in his heart.
During these sixty years, he ate alone, practiced alone, and faced the cold wall alone.
Loneliness gnaws at the soul like a poisonous snake.
But at this moment, this wisp of human smoke made his dull heart a little more alive.
Is this human fireworks?
Seems pretty good.
Li Changsheng murmured to himself.
Dinner is very simple, two bowls of porridge and a plate of pickles.
Jiang Cuiping didn't dare to serve, so she squatted by the stove with a bowl in hand.
In their host's house, the mother-in-law is not allowed to sit at the main table.
Li Changsheng frowned and waved, "Come here and sit down to eat."
"But..."
"Stop it, I'll let you come over."
"Okay!"
The girl was flattered.
He sat down half ass tremblingly.
Eating very quickly.
It was obvious that I was not used to eating at the main table and was a little scared.
It's late at night.
The cold wind howled outside, beating against the dilapidated window lattice.
Jiang Cuiping stood awkwardly beside the bed, holding the corners of her clothes tightly with her hands, her knuckles turning white.
She knew what was coming.
But don’t refuse,
Because this is her life and her only value.
No matter whether your fate is good or bad, you should carry on.
Li Changsheng sighed and looked at his old face in the mirror, full of white hair and piled wrinkles.
Look at the young girl in front of her again.
If in the previous life, this girl should still be in school!
In the world of immortality, you have to learn to serve men at a young age.
Sigh:
"I've wronged you."
Jiang Cuiping shuddered, raised her head, her eyes were slightly red: "I'm not wronged. The immortal master will provide food and a place to live. Cuiping is willing to work as a cow or horse for the immortal master in her life."
This is the truth.
In troubled times.
Being alive is the greatest blessing.
Whether a woman lives depends on the man who follows her.
"No need to call me Immortal Master."
"I have been dismissed, let's forget the past!"
"You can just call me Changsheng from now on."
Jiang Cuiping: "Okay, Master Immortal."
Li Changsheng: "What did I just say?"
Jiang Cuiping: "...Okay, longevity."
Li Changsheng blew out the candles.
The two of them lay on the creaking wooden bed.
Everything will fall into place.
Many children, many blessings.
A few hours later.
Li Changsheng felt that he had reached bliss.
The woman in his arms was exhausted, so she lay quietly on the bed and fell asleep.
Although Li Changsheng is old.
But you get stronger with age.
Ordinary women really can't compete with him.
Just when Li Changsheng was about to close his eyes and rest, something suddenly came to his mindA cold electronic synthesized electronic sound sounded.
【bite! 】
[It is detected that the host is marrying Jiang Cuiping. 】
[Considered as establishing a family. 】
[The family prosperity system is activated. 】
When Li Changsheng heard this, his whole body froze, and his cloudy eyes instantly erupted with a terrifying light.
Standard equipment for time travellers.
The system arrived sixty years late?
It's a good thing you can come.
Tongzi, give me a reward quickly!
Li Changsheng was so happy that he almost jumped up.
The next second, the cold prompt tone of the system came over.
[Although the spouse is a mortal, the host establishes a family for the first time, triggering a novice critical strike reward. 】
[Reward 1: longevity + 20 years,]
[Reward 2: Cultivation + 5 years. 】
[Reward Three: God-level Turtle Breath Technique. 】
[Reward 4: God-level camouflage. 】
[Reward 5: Reshape body functions]
[Reward 6: The true solution to the spiritual talisman. 】
Directly hit five major rewards.
And everything is good.
It’s really awesome.
Seeing such a rich reward, even if Li Changsheng's mentality was stable, his body was shaking with excitement.
[Do you want to realize the reward immediately? whether. 】
"Of course."
Li Changsheng spoke affirmatively.
As the voice fell, I suddenly felt something strange coming from my body.
A gentle force appeared out of thin air and swept through the whole body.
Skill fusion.
Cultivation increases.
Remodeling of body functions.
There is no pain at all in the process of realizing the reward, it is very comfortable.
There is an addictive feeling.
Ten minutes later.
The transformation is over.
Li Changsheng discovered that not only was his hidden injury healed, but his cultivation level had also improved by two levels.
From the third level of Qi training, he was promoted to the fifth level of Qi training.
This is really good!
I wasted sixty years in Qingyunmen.
None of them can break through the fourth level of Qi training.
Now one day to marry a wife.
But it broke through two levels in a row.
Instead of practicing hard.
It is not as practical as marrying a wife, having many children, and developing a family with great blessings.
Li Changsheng thought that he had
The person beside the pillow, Jiang Cuiping, seemed to be feeling something in a daze, and asked doubtfully:
"Changsheng, what's wrong?"
"It's okay, go to sleep."
Li Changsheng suppressed the ecstasy in his heart and spoke.
But Jiang Cuiping didn't notice that Li Changsheng's voice was much more energetic.
The next morning.
The sun shines through the window on the bedside.
Jiang Cuiping rubbed her sleepy eyes and got up to cook as a habit.
But when he saw Li Changsheng's face, he felt as if he had been struck by lightning and stood stunned on the spot.
"Ah!"
Jiang Cuiping exclaimed, then covered her mouth.
The old man with wrinkles and gray hair from last night was gone. Instead, there was a middle-aged man who looked to be in his early forties, tall and tall, with half-black hair. Although there are still fine lines at the corners of his eyes, his face is rosy and his eyes are like lightning. Where is there any trace of twilight?
"What's wrong?" Li Changsheng was getting dressed and asked doubtfully.
"Chang Sheng, you...why have you become younger? You seem to be more than ten years younger." Jiang Cuiping stammered.
"Oh? Really?"
Li Changsheng smiled calmly.
He was only focused on checking the system functions and the growth of his cultivation last night, and really didn't notice the changes in appearance.
"Yes." Jiang Cuiping replied.
Li Changsheng: "Maybe it's because I relieved the sect's burden yesterday, my thoughts are clear, the bottleneck of years of practice is loosened, and my cultivation has improved, so I naturally look younger."
